Modified build: 2.6.4-civ6.2, packaging variant 3.2.5-no-npcap, 2026-10-31
License: LGPL-3.0-only, see EasyTier-LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt.

1. Extract EasyTier-2.6.4-source.tar.gz.
2. In the extracted EasyTier source directory:
   patch -p1 < ../EasyTier-fast-failover.patch
3. Use Rust 1.95.0 and the included Cargo.lock without updating dependencies.
   Build EasyTier only, with --no-default-features --features tun,aes-gcm,zstd.
   Linux target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl (static).
   Windows target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (static CRT).
   Binaries: easytier-core and easytier-cli.

Build environment: clang/lld/llvm, protobuf compiler and standard protobuf
headers, CMake/Ninja; Zig 0.15.2 with cargo-zigbuild 0.24.0 for Linux;
cargo-xwin 0.23.1 with Microsoft CRT/SDK for Windows.
The server source bundle includes scripts/build-mesh-fork.py and
build/mesh-fork.Dockerfile for the same build. All dependencies are public.

Examples after adding the Rust targets with rustup:
  cargo zigbuild --locked --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p easytier --no-default-features --features tun,aes-gcm,zstd --bin easytier-core --bin easytier-cli
  cargo xwin build --locked --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -p easytier --no-default-features --features tun,aes-gcm,zstd --bin easytier-core --bin easytier-cli

Windows 10/11 are supported. The optional Win7 VC-LTL/YY-Thunks build
step is removed by the EasyTier patch; the standard static MSVC CRT is used.

Cargo.lock pins windivert-rust to adcc56d1550f7b5377ec2b3429f413ee24a77375.
The included windivert-rust-adcc56d-civ6-source.tar.gz contains the dependency
source used for this Windows build, including its vendored WinDivert C source.
Only two build-script path strings were changed from backslashes to slashes:
  windivert-sys/build/compile/msvc.rs: vendor/include, vendor/dll/windivert.c
No dependency runtime Rust or C code was changed. The server source package
includes scripts/fix-windivert-build.py to apply these build-only path changes
to the pinned Cargo checkout before running cargo-xwin.

Zstd is retained because upstream RPC advertises Zstd support for route sync.
Game data compression remains at its default (none).
The two Windows driver components, wintun.dll and WinDivert64.sys, remain
the upstream release files. Wintun-LICENSE.txt is the separate official
Wintun 0.14.1 prebuilt binaries license, not the source-code GPL license.

Public packaging variant 3.2.5-no-npcap:
Windows interface enumeration keeps its existing network-interface/Windows
IP Helper path. If it fails, the client logs the failure and returns an
empty interface list rather than invoking the pnet/Npcap fallback. Normal
interface enumeration and the wire format are unchanged. The displayed
native version stays 2.6.4-civ6.2. The build excludes the optional faketcp
feature, whose Windows pnet fallback would otherwise require Npcap.
Packet.dll is not shipped and Npcap is not a runtime prerequisite.

EasyTier-2.6.4-source.tar.gz preserves the upstream Rust/Cargo and all other
retained files byte-for-byte. Only Packet.dll and Packet.lib files under
easytier/third_party/{x86_64,i686,arm64} are omitted. This avoids publishing
the Npcap DLLs included in the upstream source archive. Exact original and
sanitized source archive hashes, the six omitted paths and hashes, and the
local patch hash are recorded in BUILD-MANIFEST.json.


Windows build-only import library:
pnet 0.35.0 still declares Packet.lib at link time even though this variant
has no live Packet calls. scripts/build-mesh-fork.py downloads the official
WinPcap 4.1.2 SDK, verifies the SDK and x64 import-library SHA256 hashes, and
stores only WpdPack/Lib/x64/Packet.lib in .build/mesh-build-imports. Docker
mounts this private directory at /build-imports with LIB=/build-imports.
For the manual cargo-xwin example above, set LIB to the same import-library
directory. SDK URL and both fixed hashes are in BUILD-MANIFEST.json.
WinPcap-SDK-LICENSE.txt preserves the official BSD-style license notice.
This is a build-only import library. No WinPcap/Npcap DLL, driver or installer
is shipped; the Windows client needs no Npcap installation.
